name: robots/zhefan-xu__isaac-go2-ros2
title: Unitree Go2 in Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab (rough terrain)
intro: Unitree Go2 in Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab (rough terrain), adapted from zhefan-xu/isaac-go2-ros2. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
